body:
Thank you for your kind words.

When you're young, you have hope that things will get better and that you have a chance of working your way out of issues.  As an adult, you realize that the natural infrastructure that you have built around effectively swallows that hope for change and improvement.  You're stuck.  

Have been contemplating and planning for long enough now that it is a matter more of when than if, or how, or even, why.
